english:
I offer a thousand thanks to the Blessed Mother and Holy Son. Here I am sharing my testimony. On February 17, 2025,
I came here to make the covenant. It was at a critical stage of my husband’s life that I came here. My husband was working in Adan Hospital,
Suddenly his blood pressure shot up, and a vein in his head burst. He was put on a ventilator.
I did not know anything about this. None of our family members were there. Only a cousin aunt of ours was there, along with some friends.
That cousin aunt was a person in the Kreupasanam covenant. As quickly as possible, she went near the ventilator and placed the Mother’s locket, blessed salt,
and holy oil there, and entrusted Binu to the Mother of Kreupasanam. Then she sent me a photo from there. She told me, “Come quickly to Kreupasanam,
make the covenant, and meet Father Joseph.” On that date itself, around 4:30 in the morning, I reached here. I got token number 15.
I made the covenant. In the afternoon, I was able to meet Father. I gave Father the photo of my husband lying on the ventilator. Father laid his hands and prayed.
He prayed by placing my husband before the Blessed Mother and the risen Lord Jesus.
When Father gave the photo back, I told him, “Father, he is in Kuwait. I cannot see him. Only friends and my cousins are there.”
Father looked once more at the Mother and said, “Okay.”
When I returned from here to Kumarakom, I received the joyful news that my husband had opened his eyes. Then again, his BP shot
up. A drain had been inserted, there was bleeding, and he was in a critical stage under sedation. Again the BP was shooting up.
We prayed in this way, using all the blessed articles of the Mother. From home I prayed.
I received two bundles of the Kreupasanam newsletter from here, which I distributed house to house.
Then I went to meet the poor, visited the sick, applied the covenant oil, and prayed for many patients.
They were healed, and they came here and made the covenant. Then I also gave out food packets. From the ventilator, on March 1st, we received a good report.
One, two, three good reports came on Saturday, Sunday, and Monday. They stopped the ventilator support and sedation. Binu opened his eyes and spoke.
This was joyful news my Mother gave me. Then, on the 4th day, Tuesday, while I was attending Father Joseph’s Kreupasanam adoration,
I got a phone call from Kuwait saying, “We are going to remove Binu from the ventilator. Liji, stay in prayer.” I said, “Sister, I am staying in prayer.”
Before that, the doctors had said that when removing him from the ventilator, they would need to do a tracheostomy. From 12 midnight till 3 a.m.,
I prayed the Rosary of the Mother: “Do not let them cut my husband. My Mother, bring him back alive to me. He is my life partner.
We have no other way of life. He is the father of my child, my husband, the head of my family.
However he went there, let him come back the same way. My Mother, he is the son you have given me.”
I prayed like that. He came off the ventilator very well, and there was no need for a tracheostomy.
At the very time of Father’s adoration, they removed him from the ventilator. A good report came. All the tubes were removed.
Then our cousin aunt went there and asked Binu, “Who is this?” He said, “My wife.” He recognized all of us. That same day, he was shifted to the isolation ward.
He was under treatment there for a month. Then he was brought home to India, arriving in a wheelchair. Then we showed him at Indo Medical Hospital in Vaikom.
For every test done there, I applied Kreupasanam Mother’s salt, oil, and locket.
Not a single bad report came. All the reports were favorable. There was no problem at all. They said he could be discharged home.
They said the medicines should not be stopped, and must be taken for six months. On the 14th of this month, it will be six months since this stroke happened. My husband’s right leg—
Only a slight stiffness remains, everything else my Mother has taken away. With physiotherapy, now he has completely recovered.
Then, to educate our children, I had no other means. This was the only way of life we had. They are studying in CBSE.
The fees there are very high. I cried and prayed that they should continue their studies there. That too my Mother granted me.
We have had many financial difficulties. We had many debts, but the Mother of God sent angels in ways I did not know and helped us.
Even till today, for any financial matter, God has never let us lack. Jesus and Mother have never let us lack anything.
Through the covenant life, I was able to grow spiritually. I could share the Word, read the Bible, recite the Rosary of the Mother at 3 a.m. on my knees,
and watch Father’s Daily Bread at 5:30. In all this, my Mother guided me. According to my ability, I first bought two bundles of the newsletters.
Then it was not enough. People came asking, “Do you have any newsletters?” Then I came here again and bought three bundles more.
Every month I come here and buy five bundles of newsletters, which I distribute at auto stands, hospitals, shops, churches, everywhere.
I also give food packets to the poor sitting on the roadside. Then I help poor people who have no means to buy medicines.
For all this that my Mother and Jesus have given me, I offer a thousand thanks and end my testimony here.
A thousand thanks to Jesus and Mother who gave my life back.
John 11:4: This sickness will not end in death, but is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.
This is the testimony shared by Sister Liji Binu, whose husband faced a critical illness unexpectedly. She, following the message given to her,
came to Kreupasanam, made the covenant, prayed, and fully entrusted her husband’s life and sickness into the hands of the Mother.
She testifies: when my life partner was in a very critical condition abroad on a ventilator, I came weeping to the Mother, made the covenant,
and showed Father Joseph her's husband’s photo. Father prayed, entrusting him to the Mother and to Jesus. Then again, crying, she told Father,
“My husband must come back alive to me and return home.” Father said “Okay” and blessed her.
From then on, every moment, whether in the hospital or at home, I kept entrusting my husband’s condition into the hands of the Mother,
continually offering him into her great protection. Through this, countless blessings were received, which Sister testified to— especially that at the very moment he was removed from the ventilator, it coincided with Father’s adoration…
In that healing adoration, she entrusted her husband and prayed with just one intention: “Do not cut him anymore, do not put another tube for breathing.
Instead, heal him completely and remove him from the ventilator.” That was the only intention.
She says that without any difficulty, crossing over all the dangerous conditions, her husband returned to a normal state. Gradually, all the sickness was healed,
and under the full protection of the Mother, life was restored, health returned, and he was able to live joyfully with his family.
She says that this was possible because in the covenant we always write our intentions for big matters. When we write down things that seem impossible,
even when disasters multiply beyond measure, we write intentions for those disasters to be removed. Because of the Marian Covenant of the Blessed Mother of Kreupasanam,
in situations where I could never change anything by my own ability, or with my wealth, or with my knowledge, or with the medicines I was taking,
when I placed the intention in the covenant, the same Mother who appeared alive in this shrine stood with us, and gave healing,
comfort, and hope, strengthening life and family. This is the testimony this family shares at this altar: from death to life,
from sickness to health, into a life that glorifies the name of God, this family was led and blessed in these days by the Blessed Mother and Holy Son.
With clapping of hands, let us offer this testimony in thanksgiving. Extraordinary divine experiences can also be yours.
